meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Run a dependency graph of child agents in one call with the native dag tool. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行多个依赖子任务,一次调用完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要同时运行多个子任务,且任务间有先后依赖。
copy.tagline_en: Execute multiple dependent subtasks in one call.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run multiple subtasks with dependencies in a single orchestrated call.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把复杂任务拆成若干子任务,按依赖关系分层、并行地分派给多个子代理执行,并在运行中监控进度、纠正偏差。它还会先做规划、登记目标,最后用证据验证结果,而不是只看子代理自报完成。
howto.when: 当用户提到 mass-ulw、任务 DAG、扇出/扇入工作,或要求多代理执行且有任务必须等待其它任务完成时,技能会接管。

say.text: 用 dag 跑一个任务图:先审计文档,再重写,最后验证
say.note: 会按依赖分波执行并验证

say.text: 帮我做 mass-ulw,任务 C 依赖 A 和 B
say.note: 先建图,再并行跑 A、B,最后跑 C

say.text: 这次多代理工作需要扇出/扇入,请用 dag 编排

howto.what_en: Claude breaks a complex task into subtasks and runs them as a dependency graph, dispatching child agents in parallel waves as dependencies clear. It plans first, registers the goal, and verifies results with evidence instead of trusting self-reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Run a task DAG: audit docs, then rewrite, then verify.
Use mass-ulw with task C depending on A and B.
say_en.note: A and B run in parallel, then C.

say_en.text: This multi-agent job needs fan-out/fan-in; orchestrate with dag.
